title: Systematic Literature Review of Machine Learning Models and Applications for Text Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2608.26500v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) for text recognition using machine vision has significantly improved, particularly when handling heterogeneous textual data. Traditional OCR models struggle with script variations, writing styles, and degraded documents. Advancements in technology are leading to new AI models with improved architecture for handling multiple languages and complex data formats. Despite this progress, a comprehensive evaluation of OCR advancements remains limited. Based on the established preferred reporting items for systematic reviews and meta-analysis (PRISMA) guidelines, this literature review presents an extensive assessment of OCR research to trace the evolution of AI models over the past decade. It explores the transition in AI models, application domains, data types, linguistic coverage, and challenges. translated_title: 机器学习模型与文本识别应用的系统文献综述
translated_abstract: 摘要：利用机器视觉进行文本识别的光学字符识别（OCR）技术已显著改进，尤其是在处理异构文本数据时。传统OCR模型在应对字体变化、书写风格和退化文档方面存在困难。技术进步正在催生具有改进架构的新型AI模型，以处理多种语言和复杂数据格式。尽管取得了这些进展，但对OCR进展的全面评估仍然有限。基于既定的系统评价和荟萃分析首选报告项目（PRISMA）指南，本文献综述对OCR研究进行了广泛评估，以追溯过去十年AI模型的演变。它探讨了AI模型、应用领域、数据类型、语言覆盖范围及挑战方面的转变。通过对2015年1月至2025年1月期间发表的97项选定研究的详细分析，本综述揭示了关键OCR模型的发展趋势与局限性。
tldr: 本综述基于PRISMA指南系统评估了2015-2025年间97项OCR研究，总结了AI模型在文本识别中的演变趋势及面临的挑战。
en_tdlr: This review systematically evaluates 97 OCR studies from 2015-2025 based on PRISMA guidelines, summarizing AI model evolution trends and challenges in text recognition.
